title: Unfall zwischen Fahrrad und E-Scooter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe

extraction.summaryEn: A cyclist was hit head-on on the bike lane of Großbeerenstraße by an e-scooter that had ridden onto it from the pavement; the two e-scooter riders fled the scene. The 54-year-old cyclist suffered several fractures and was hospitalized.
